objective: Compare a completed-minute vendor-VWAP directional entry with the same entry confirmed by causal five-minute momentum and path efficiency.
replication_status: Explicit NSE adaptation. Not an exact replication of the paper.

combination.weight_learning: None. Fixed confirmation filter, no estimated accuracy claim.

selection: Same prior-date 12-stock universe as research/common, no re-selection.
success_criterion: Positive aggregate cost-adjusted PnL in both validation_diagnostic and historical_audit phases with complete sessions; receipt-proxy success alone cannot qualify for deployment.
restrictions: Do not tune thresholds after observing results. Existing dates were previously inspected, so no pristine holdout.
